text: Context is everything Claude can see at the moment it answers you.
Picture Claude sitting at a desk.
Only what is on that desk is available to work with: your instructions, the conversation history, files you shared, and tool results.
Anything not on the desk simply does not exist for Claude.
But the desk has a size limit called the context window.
When a chat grows too long or files too large, the desk clutters, causing Claude to lose track of details.
Keep your context clean: start a fresh chat for each new task, and share only the specific pages and files that matter.
